blacklistabilityReview.evidence: Ethereum holds 100% of circulating supply. At ethereum@26224760 (2026-10-19T06:14:11+00:00; hash 0x2a6c0b20faae49bb23f77a582b517057741efcee5bd423a8552f672144c83b85; observed 2026-10-19T06:19:28.419767+00:00) via https://ethereum-rpc.publicnode.com, 0x557ab1e003951a73c12d16f0fea8490e39c33c35 exactly matches the verified nonproxy SavingsReUSD runtime, with zero EIP-1967 implementation/admin/beacon slots. The verified SavingsReUSD, LinearRewardsErc4626 and Solmate ERC-20/ERC-4626 source contain no holder blacklist, transfer pause, seizure, upgrade path or arbitrary-holder burn. Native withdrawals burn holder shares under ordinary allowance rules; maxWithdraw/maxRedeem are balance-based and there is no configurable owner/receiver allowlist or withdrawal-limiter module. Core ownership and reward/bridge configuration do not authorize freezing local holder balances; owner remains 0xc07e000044f95655c11fda4cd37f70a94d7e0a7d, msgInspector is zero, and asset() returns reUSD 0x57ab1e0003f623289cd798b1824be09a793e4bec. The wrapper is a 100% claim on reusd-resupply, not a separate reserve portfolio. With that parent's corrected No verdict, neither parent inheritance nor a >50% issuer/custodian reserve majority qualifies. No is conditional on the reUSD and crvUSD classifications; if reUSD remains Upstream, this wrapper remains Upstream.

oracleRisk.summary: sreUSD values local shares from onchain REUSD custody and vested-reward accounting. It has no local collateral-liquidation engine or external market-price oracle; parent price and upstream mechanism risk remain inherited.

branchApplicability.rationale: The ERC-4626 share-to-underlying exchange rate is the top-level mint/redemption authority. There are no borrower-owned collateral branches on the savings token.
